system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Ask about the latest cricket match scores and player statistics.

function.name: horti_get_crop_calendar
function.description: Retrieves the full crop calendar for a horticulture crop in a specific region. Includes stage-wise milestones (land prep, sowing, vegetative, flowering, harvesting) with recommended dates. PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Does NOT provide detailed stage advisory. Fails if crop_type is unsupported for the region or location invalid.

function.name: horti_track_grievance_status
function.description: Tracks horticulture advisory grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized advisory tools.
